subject: Convergence plan: starter doc & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@sigmahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Convergence plan: starter doc & evaluation timeline

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I put together a lightweight starter document (MAP-style) and a proposed evaluation timeline so your team can see a pragmatic route to a 30–60 day pilot. I'm attaching the editable starter doc and a slide with the proposed milestones.

Quick summary / ask:
- Please review the "Convergence Starter" doc (link below) and add any missing stakeholders or constraints.
- Can you confirm the internal evaluation criteria (security, perf targets, data residency needs) by EOW?
- If the timeline looks OK, we'll lock a 60-minute kickoff workshop next week to align owners and success metrics.

Links & attachments:
- Starter doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_convergence_starter
- Milestone slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/4D5e6F_eval_timeline
- Attachment: convergence-starter-template-v1.gdoc (application/vnd.google-apps.document)
- Attachment: eval-timeline-proposal-v1.gslides (application/vnd.google-apps.presentation)

Proposed initial cadence (draft):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment/access check
- Week 1–2: Ingest sample data + baseline perf
- Week 3–4: Model tuning & integration checks
- Week 5–8: User acceptance & go/no-go decision

I'll hold a few calendar options once you confirm the general availability.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: eval-timeline-proposal-v1.gslides]

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Convergence plan: starter doc & evaluation timeline

Vanessa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft materials. I skimmed both and they look promising. A couple of items from my side before we lock the kickoff: 

- Can you add a brief "evaluation criteria" section to the starter doc that lists the security evidence we need (SOC 2, encryption-at-rest, audit logs) and the performance benchmarks (p95 latency targets, throughput for 10k req/day)?
- Our compliance owner (Tom) flagged that we need a KMS/HSM integration plan and the ability to run in our EU region for PHI-related telemetry. Is that captured anywhere in the doc?
- Also, please attach any sample SOC 2 artifact or the compliance questionnaire — that will speed our internal review.

Tom and I are generally available next Tue/Wed mornings Pacific for a kickoff.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno
Director of Data Platforms | Sigma Health
alyssa@sigmahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0987
